deepsop-kuaishou-ai 1.0.0 changelog

- Initial release with 快手视频/图文自动上传 capabilities.
- Integrates with social-auto-upload for automated environment setup; no manual installation required.
- Supports login, cookie validation, video uploads, and photo-note uploads via CLI subcommands.
- Includes agent behavior guidelines for robust environment preparation and command execution.
- Provides troubleshooting, template files, and workflow documentation for end users.
